name: Code section for patches
description: Adds an empty 16 KiB section to the executable so other fixes have room for new code. Applied automatically when a fix needs it and removed when none does.

edits.note: section header .tyrs: VA 0xE89000, raw 0xDC1C00, 0x4000 bytes (2.0.0: 0x2000, 1.0.0: 0x1000), code+RWX
appended section body, INT3-filled; patches that require this write into it (2.0.0: 0x2000 bytes, 1.0.0: 0x1000)
